Avatar Group

Avatar groups stack member avatars with a negative overlap. They support an overflow counter and can be combined with tooltips for quick identification.

Stacked Avatars

Wrap avatars in .zak-avatar-group to overlap them automatically.

JA MK SR AL RS
HTML
<div class="zak-avatar-group">
  <span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-primary">JA</span>
  <span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-success">MK</span>
  <span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-warning">SR</span>
  <span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-danger">AL</span>
</div>

Avatar Group with Max Count

Show a limited number of avatars and append .zak-avatar-more to indicate the remaining count.

JA MK SR +12
HTML
<div class="zak-avatar-group">
  <span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-primary">JA</span>
  <span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-success">MK</span>
  <span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-warning">SR</span>
  <span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-more">+12</span>
</div>

Avatar Group with Tooltips

Add title attributes (native tooltips) or wire the ZAKUIKit tooltip component for rich identification on hover.

JA MK SR +11
HTML
<div class="zak-avatar-group">
  <a href="#" class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-primary" title="Janet Fox - Product Designer">JA</a>
  <a href="#" class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-success" title="Mark Kim - Frontend Engineer">MK</a>
  <a href="#" class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-more" title="View all 14 members">+11</a>
</div>

Image Avatars in a Group

Image avatars work identically inside groups.

+9
HTML
<div class="zak-avatar-group">
  <span class="zak-avatar"><img src="..." alt="Janet Fox"></span>
  <span class="zak-avatar"><img src="..." alt="Mark Kim"></span>
  <span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-more">+9</span>
</div>

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-avatar-groupFlex container with overlapping avatars
.zak-avatarIndividual avatar (see Avatar documentation)
.zak-avatar-moreOverflow counter avatar showing remaining count

Accessibility

  • Each avatar in a group needs an accessible name via alt, aria-label or associated visible text.
  • When the overflow counter (+N) is meaningful, replace it with "View N more members" for screen readers.
  • If group members are interactive, use links/buttons and ensure keyboard focus reaches each one.
  • Hover-only tooltips should also work on keyboard focus for users navigating without a pointer.
